doc: Ichimoku Kinko Hyo (Goichi Hosoda, Ichimoku Kinko Hyo, 1969; in English Nicole Elliott, Ichimoku Charts, Harriman House 2007). Canonical parameters 9/26/52 with displacement 26: Tenkan-sen is the midpoint of the 9-bar high and low, Kijun-sen of the 26-bar; Senkou Span A is their mean and Span B the 52-bar midpoint, both drawn 26 bars ahead, the cloud (kumo) between them coloured by which span leads; Chikou Span is the close drawn 26 bars back. Read: price above the cloud is bullish, below bearish, inside neutral; Tenkan over Kijun is the signal line; the Chikou clear of the price of 26 bars ago confirms. The 9/26/52 bar counts are Hosoda's, set for a six-day trading week; this preset keeps them on daily bars.
